summary: Phase 6 of plan v3 (plans/03_direct-route-forest.md) landed sorry-free and axiom-clean in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Constructive/Labelled/Soundness.lean: `IsDerivationForest (G : Graph Atom) : Prop` (the three conjuncts -- G.X.Finite, graded rank `∃ ht, ∀ a b, G.R a b → ht b = ht a + 1`, unique parent `∀ a₁ a₂ b, G.R a₁ b → G.R a₂ b → a₁ = a₂` -- exactly as specified, no conjunct dropped), `forest_trivial : IsDerivationForest (Graph.trivial Atom)` (2-line term-mode proof, vacuous over Graph.trivial's empty edge relation), and `forest_addEdge_fresh : IsDerivationForest G → x ∈ G.X → y ∉ G.X → IsDerivationForest (G.addEdge x y)` (tactic-mode, ~30 lines, extending the rank via `Function.update ht y (ht x + 1)`). No new axiom, no Graph structure modification, no Preserved Asset touched. Pure graph scaffolding with zero dependency on the model or forcing relation, exactly matching the audit's recommended shape (report 03 §1-3).
next_phase_hint: Phase 7: state and prove the tree-restricted boxI_lift (Simpson 8.1.3, chunk 0155), taking IsDerivationForest G as a hypothesis, completing the finite-component cascade boxI_lift_star left open. This is the plan's sole concentrated-risk phase (engineering, not mathematics) -- recommend landing the helper raise_component_by_distance as its own green sub-step before assembling boxI_lift.
deviations: forest_addEdge_fresh's graded-rank case originally used `rcases hab with hab | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩` on the new-edge disjunct `a = x ∧ b = y`; Lean's subst eliminated the outer binders `x`/`y` (substituting them with `a`/`b`) rather than the reverse, which orphaned subsequent bare references to `x`/`y` (build error: "unknown identifier x/y"). Fixed by keeping the equalities as named hypotheses `ha : a = x`, `hb : b = y` and rewriting the goal with them (`rw [ha, hb, ...]`) instead of destructive `subst`/`rfl`-pattern. No change to the lemma's statement, scope, or the plan's task sequence -- purely a tactic-level fix, verified green.
